challenge.title: A Shopping Trip in Shorja
challenge.instructions: Write and act a shopping conversation of at least 10 lines. It must include asking for an item by size, discussing a color, checking the price, bargaining at least once, and a return or exchange with the receipt mentioned. Use at least 8 target phrases from Unit 6 and include both a masculine and a feminine form of address.
required_elements: An opening request using أريد and a clothing item.
A size question using شنو قياسك؟ or شنو قياسچ؟
A color question or preference using اللون.
A price question using بكم or شكد.
At least one bargaining line using تقدر تنزّل السعر؟ or نزّلي شوية.
A final price line using آخر سعر.
A return or exchange line using أرجّع or أبدّل.
A mention of the receipt using الوصل.
A closing thank-you such as مشكور or يعطيك العافية.

dialogue.english: This is very expensive, can you lower the price?

dialogue.speaker: Abu Ali
dialogue.arabic: أنزّلك لتسعة آلاف، هذا آخر سعر.
dialogue.transliteration: anazzilak li-tis3at aalaaf, haadha aakhir si3ir.
dialogue.english: I'll lower it to nine thousand for you, this is the final price.

dialogue.speaker: Samer
dialogue.english: Good, we agreed.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.arabic: (بعد يومين) السلام عليكم عمي، أريد أرجّع هذا القميص، بيه عيب.
dialogue.transliteration: (ba3d yomeen) salaam 3aleekum 3ammi, areed arajji3 haadha l-gameeS, biyya 3ayb.
dialogue.english: (Two days later) Peace be upon you uncle, I want to return this shirt, it has a defect.

dialogue.speaker: Abu Ali
dialogue.english: What's the problem? Do you have the receipt?

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.english: Yes, I have it. The seam is open.

dialogue.speaker: Abu Ali
dialogue.english: Good. Do you want to return it or exchange it?

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.english: I want to exchange it for a slightly bigger size.

dialogue.speaker: Abu Ali
dialogue.english: Sure, one moment, I'll bring it for you.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.english: Thank you for your help, may God give you strength.
